finding.VGL-C001: Upgrades program {program:address} with the code in buffer {buffer:address} (executable hash {bufferHash:hash}; current verification of the program: {verification:verification})
finding.VGL-C002.external: Hands the upgrade authority of program {program:address} to {newAuthority:address}, which is NOT a vault of this multisig: that address could then replace the program's code at any time
finding.VGL-C002.external.without.progra: Hands the upgrade authority of {account:address} to {newAuthority:address}, which is NOT a vault of this multisig: that address could then replace the code at any time
finding.VGL-C002.immutable: Removes the upgrade authority of program {program:address}: it can never be changed again. This cannot be undone.
finding.VGL-C002.immutable.without.progr: Removes the upgrade authority of {account:address}: if this is a program, it can never be changed again. This cannot be undone.
finding.VGL-C002.ownVault: Hands the upgrade authority of program {program:address} from {oldAuthority:address} to {newAuthority:address}, a vault of this multisig or one of your known addresses
finding.VGL-C002.ownVault.without.progra: Hands the upgrade authority of {account:address} from {oldAuthority:address} to {newAuthority:address}, a vault of this multisig or one of your known addresses
finding.VGL-C003.removed: Permanently removes the {authorityType:authority} of {account:address} (held by {oldAuthority:address}). This cannot be undone.
finding.VGL-C004: Lets {delegate:address} move up to {amount:token} out of {source:address} at any time, without another vote
finding.VGL-C005: Changes the owner program of {account:address} to {owner:address}: that program gets full control of the account and everything in it
finding.VGL-C006.addMember: Adds {member:address} as a member of the multisig, with permissions: {permissions:permissions}
finding.VGL-C006.configAuthority: Sets the config authority of the multisig to {newConfigAuthority:address}: that address will be able to change the multisig's settings without a vote
finding.VGL-C006.rentCollector: Sets the rent collector (who receives the rent of closed Squads accounts) to {newRentCollector:address}
finding.VGL-C006.spendingLimitAdded: Adds a spending limit on vault #{vaultIndex}: {members} member(s) can spend up to {amount:token} {period:period} without a vote, to {destinations} allowed destination(s)
finding.VGL-C006.spendingLimitAdded.with: Adds a spending limit on vault #{vaultIndex}: {members} member(s) can spend up to {amount:token} {period:period} without a vote, to any address
finding.VGL-C006.threshold: Changes the approval threshold from {oldThreshold} to {newThreshold}
finding.VGL-C006.thresholdLowered: LOWERS the approval threshold from {oldThreshold} to {newThreshold}: fewer members will be needed to approve transactions
finding.VGL-C006.timeLock: Changes the time lock from {oldTimeLock:duration} to {newTimeLock:duration}
finding.VGL-C006.timeLockLowered: LOWERS the time lock from {oldTimeLock:duration} to {newTimeLock:duration}: approved transactions can be executed sooner, leaving less time to react
finding.VGL-C007.authorize: Changes the {stakeAuthorize:stakeAuthorize} of stake account {stake:address} from {oldAuthority:address} to {newAuthority:address}
finding.VGL-C007.custodian: Sets {newAuthority:address} as the new lockup custodian of stake account {stake:address}: the custodian can lift the lockup
finding.VGL-C008: {address} looks like the known address {resembles} (same first and last four characters) but is a different address: possible address poisoning
finding.VGL-C009.loader: Closes {account:address} (a program or buffer account) and sends its lamports to {destination:address}, which is not a vault of this multisig. Closing a program's data account deletes the program permanently.
finding.VGL-C009.token: Closes token account {account:address} and sends its lamports to {destination:address}, which is not a vault of this multisig
finding.VGL-C010: Part of the transaction cannot be resolved, so what it does cannot be fully shown: {code:gap}
finding.VGL-C011: Upgrade buffer {buffer:address} is controlled by {bufferAuthority:address}, not by the vault performing the upgrade: its contents could be changed after the vote
finding.VGL-I001.defaultLimit: Priority fee of {price:number} micro-lamports per compute unit, with the default compute-unit limit
finding.VGL-I001.fee: Maximum priority fee {fee:sol} ({price:number} micro-lamports per unit × {limit:number} compute units)
finding.VGL-I001.inProposal: The proposal contains Compute Budget instructions; they have no effect inside a proposal
finding.VGL-I001.v1: Priority fee set in the transaction itself (v1): {fee:sol}
finding.VGL-I003: Uses {count} address lookup table(s): accounts loaded from them are not written in the transaction itself
finding.VGL-I004.Active: Voting open: {approvals} of {threshold} approvals ({remaining} more needed), {rejections} rejection(s)
finding.VGL-I004.Draft: Draft: not yet open for voting ({approvals} of {threshold} approvals)
finding.VGL-I004.approvedReady: Approved ({approvals} of {threshold}) and can be executed now
finding.VGL-I004.approvedWaiting: Approved ({approvals} of {threshold}); can be executed in {secondsLeft:duration} (time lock {timeLock:duration})
finding.VGL-I004.missing: No proposal exists yet for this transaction, so it cannot be voted on (threshold {threshold}, time lock {timeLock:duration})
finding.VGL-I005.Cancelled: Proposal #{transactionIndex} was cancelled and can no longer be executed
finding.VGL-I005.Rejected: Proposal #{transactionIndex} was rejected and can no longer be executed
finding.VGL-I005.staleConfig: Proposal #{transactionIndex} is stale: the multisig's settings changed after it was created, and a stale settings proposal can never be executed
finding.VGL-I005.staleNotApproved: Proposal #{transactionIndex} is stale: it was not approved before the multisig's settings changed, so it can no longer be approved or executed
finding.VGL-W001: An instruction for program {program:address} could not be decoded: what it does is unknown
finding.VGL-W002.unknown: The verification status of program {program:address} could not be established
finding.VGL-W002.unverified: Program {program:address} is not a verified build: its code cannot be matched to published source
finding.VGL-W003: Program {program:address} can be upgraded by {authority:address}, outside this multisig: its behaviour could change between the vote and execution
finding.VGL-W004.absolute: Moves {amount:token} out of {from:address}, at or above your threshold for this asset
finding.VGL-W004.share: Moves {amount:token} out of {from:address}: {share}% of its balance in this asset (threshold {threshold}%)
finding.VGL-W005: New destination: {destination:address} received nothing in the vault's last {historyDepth} transactions
finding.VGL-W007: The simulation shows {count} balance change(s) that no decoded instruction explains
finding.VGL-W008.characters: Token {mint:address} declares a name or symbol with suspicious characters: “{declaredSymbol:text}” (“{declaredName:text}”)
finding.VGL-W008.impersonation: Token {mint:address} calls itself “{declaredSymbol:text}” (“{declaredName:text}”), which looks like {registrySymbol}, but it is not the real {registrySymbol} mint
finding.VGL-W009: Uses a durable nonce (account {nonceAccount:address}, authority {nonceAuthority:address}): once signed, this transaction never expires and can be submitted at any later time
finding.VGL-W010.controlled: This multisig has a config authority, {configAuthority:address}, that can change its settings without a vote
finding.VGL-W010.threshold: Any single member of this multisig can approve transactions alone (threshold 1, {members} members)
finding.VGL-W011: The analysis is incomplete ({count} gap(s)): parts of this transaction could not be checked, so the absence of other findings does not mean it is harmless
finding.proposed: Proposed only: this transaction creates the Squads proposal, and this happens only if the proposal is later approved and executed.

gap.ACCOUNT_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE: An instruction refers to an account that is not in the transaction.
gap.ACCOUNT_UNRESOLVED: Some accounts could not be identified because their lookup table could not be read.
gap.EMBEDDED_MESSAGE_INVALID: A transaction carried inside a Squads instruction could not be decoded.
gap.EMBEDDED_MESSAGE_IN_BUFFER: The transaction is assembled in a Squads buffer across several transactions and cannot be shown from this instruction alone.
gap.IDL_AT_URL: A program publishes its own description (IDL) at an external web address. Vigil never opens links found on the chain, so what this instruction does is unknown.
gap.IDL_FETCH_FAILED: A program's own description (IDL) could not be read from the chain, so its instructions are not decoded.
gap.IDL_INVALID: A program's published description (IDL) is invalid or unsafe to use, so its instructions are not decoded.
gap.IDL_UNSUPPORTED: A program's description (IDL) is stored in a form Vigil cannot read yet, so its instructions are not decoded.
gap.INSTRUCTION_ARGS_NOT_DECODED: An instruction was identified, but its details were not decoded.
gap.LOOKUP_TABLE_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE: The transaction refers to a lookup table entry that does not exist.
gap.LOOKUP_TABLE_INVALID: An address lookup table used by the transaction is invalid.
gap.LOOKUP_TABLE_NOT_FOUND: An address lookup table used by the transaction does not exist.
gap.MALFORMED_INSTRUCTION: An instruction's data is malformed: it may fail or behave unexpectedly.
gap.PROGRAM_VERIFICATION_UNKNOWN: The verification status of a program could not be established.
gap.RPC_TRANSACTION_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: The RPC endpoint cannot return newer (v1) transactions, so some may be missing.
gap.SIMULATION_DISABLED: Simulation was turned off, so the balances this transaction changes were not checked.
gap.TOKEN_DECIMALS_UNKNOWN: A token amount is shown in base units because its token or decimals could not be read.
gap.TRANSFER_BALANCE_UNKNOWN: The balance a transfer draws on could not be read, so whether the transfer is large could not be judged.
gap.UNKNOWN_INSTRUCTION: An instruction could not be identified, so what it does is unknown.
gap.UNKNOWN_PROGRAM: An instruction calls a program Vigil cannot decode, so what it does is unknown.
